units.name: TaskWaitList
units.summary: X = wait list: link the current task into it, save the caller's return as its resume address and switch tasks.

units.name: TaskSuspend
units.summary: Save the caller's return as the current task's resume and switch tasks.

units.name: TaskSaveResume
units.summary: Y = slot: pop the return address into its resume entry; carry clear also ends the current task.

units.name: TaskKill
units.summary: Y = slot: overwrite that task's resume address so that the next time it is dispatched it simply ends. The caller continues normally.

units.name: TaskEnd
units.summary: Scheduler: end the current task and dispatch the next ready one. With no ready task, enable NMI and idle until NMI readies something; tasks run with NMI disabled. The stack is reset to $FF for every task.

units.name: TaskInit
units.summary: Clear all scheduler tables ($0600-$06FF), empty the ready stack and make slot 1 the current task.
